nota: F134: 'Antivenom has been available in Australia from the Commonwealth Serum Laboratories since 1930'. Winkel 2006: 'Commercial antivenom manufacture began in Australia in 1930 with the tiger snake antivenom'. F135: 'antivenom is available for all snakes that are native to Australia' (healthdirect; volátil). PENDENTE f125, ACHADO (Winkel, Mirtschin & Pearn, Toxicon 2006, resumo): 'This was followed by other antivenoms for the other important species (1955: taipan; 1956: brown snake; 1958: death adder; 1959: Papuan black snake; 1961: sea snake; 1962: polyvalent)'. A classe inteira tem SEIS anos, não quatro: se a régua for à tela, entram também 1959 (Papuan black snake) e 1961 (sea snake), ou a régua diz 'SELECTED'.
